name: Rocket Stick 1.2g Rosin Injected Donut - Gravity Glue
description:
Rocket Stick 1.2G Rosin-Injected Donut — Gravity Glue

Premium flower meets solventless power. The Rocket Stick Gravity Glue donut is a 1.2-gram infused pre-roll, hand-crafted and injected with live rosin for an extra-potent, flavor-packed smoke — finished with a smooth glass tip for a clean, comfortable pull. No device, no charging, just spark and go.

Gravity Glue brings a bold, gassy flavor: earthy pine and diesel notes layered with a rich, chocolatey-coffee depth and a smooth, pungent finish — all carried by the full-spectrum character of solventless rosin. Because it's infused with real rosin, every pull delivers deeper flavor and a heavier, more well-rounded effect that leans deeply relaxed and couch-locking — smooth, potent, and built to satisfy experienced smokers looking to fully unwind.

Why you'll love it:

1.2G infused pre-roll — quality flower injected with live rosin for extra potency
Solventless rosin — full-spectrum flavor and effect
Glass tip — smooth, clean pulls and a comfortable mouthpiece
Signature Gravity Glue flavor — earthy pine and diesel with chocolatey-coffee depth
Ready to enjoy — no setup, no battery, just light and go

Bold flavor, premium rosin potency, and effortless convenience in one ready-to-smoke donut. Rocket Stick Gravity Glue is ready whenever you are.
